Thanks Alex — Wed 7/15 10:00 PT works, I’ve tentatively booked the slot and will send a calendar invite after confirming with Aditya and Priyom.

To answer the two bullets you called out:
- $/1M tokens drivers: batching and caching reduce per-token GPU cycles; model selection & quantization can change throughput by ~1.5–3x. In practice, for your workload we expect the delta between unoptimized vs optimized paths to move $/1M tokens from ~ $650 -> $320 (example). The attached projected-token-model has toggles for batching factor, cache hit rate, and quantization.
- $/feature example (quick sketch):
  • Chat Assist: avg tokens/session 1.2k -> at 100k sessions/month = 120M tokens/month -> incremental cost = (120 * $/1M tokens). If $/1M tokens = $350 -> cost = $42k/mo.
  • Margin target: if feature drives $120k/mo in incremental ARR, margin on that feature w/ $42k cost = 65% (before CAC).

Action items for the deep-dive (so Aditya/Priyom come prepared):
1) Finalize token volumes: baseline (60M) vs target launch (100M) vs peak.
2) Confirm budget band ($30k–$50k/mo) and whether we should model expansion scenarios.
3) Provide the LTV uplift or revenue per feature so SE can model payback and margin.
4) SE to bring a draft $/feature worksheet and sensitivity table (batching/cache/quant).

Alex — sending calendar invite now. Priyom/Aditya — please prep the $/feature worksheet + a short slide with assumptions we’ll present.

Best,
Marissa
